adFlags.description: adAuthorization, brandOrganicType, adLabelVersion, aigcLabelType, moderationAigcLabelType and isAiGenerated; empty subkeys are omitted
adFlags.title: Ad / AI Flags

author.description: Author profile snapshot; includes commentSetting, duetSetting, stitchSetting, downloadSetting and isEmbedBanned when present. avatarUrl uses a KV URL after rehosting and avatarUrlOriginal keeps the signed source.
author.title: Author

categoryId.description: Requested category ID. All is 120; legacy 123 inputs are normalized to 120.
categoryId.title: Category ID

categoryName.description: Canonical requested category name (e.g. All, Sports, Technology)
categoryName.title: Category Name

collectCount.description: Number of times post was saved/collected
collectCount.title: Collect Count

createTime.description: Unix timestamp when the post was created
createTime.title: Create Time

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of post creation
createdAt.title: Created At

duetEnabled.description: Whether duets are allowed on this post
duetEnabled.title: Duet Enabled

engagementRate.description: (likes + comments + shares + collects) / plays, 6 decimals. Omitted when playCount is zero or missing.
engagementRate.title: Engagement Rate

feedType.description: Always 'explore' for rows from this actor
feedType.title: Feed Type

firstSeen.description: Present only for onlyNew runs: ISO timestamp when the post first entered the state store
firstSeen.title: First Seen

images.description: Slideshow images for photo posts (postType='slideshow'). With rehosting, urlList becomes a single KV image URL and urlListOriginal keeps the signed candidate list.
images.title: Images

isAd.description: Whether the post is marked as an advertisement
isAd.title: Is Ad

isNew.description: Present only for onlyNew runs; true for posts emitted during this run
isNew.title: Is New

itemCategoryId.description: The item's own CategoryType. Explore feeds are mixed, so this can differ from categoryId.
itemCategoryId.title: Item Category ID

lastSeen.description: Present only for onlyNew runs: ISO timestamp for this observation
lastSeen.title: Last Seen

locationCreated.description: Declared for backward compatibility. The Explore item payload does not contain it; it is emitted only when includePostDetails=true and the post detail page supplies a value.
locationCreated.title: Location Created (legacy)

marketRegion.description: Selected ISO country, or the actual region detected from the Explore page state when no country was requested. Never guessed.
marketRegion.title: Market Region

mediaExpiresAt.description: Per-asset ISO 8601 expiries: video, cover, avatar, music, subtitles
mediaExpiresAt.title: Media Expiries

mediaRehosted.description: True when the video bytes were stored in the default Key-Value Store, or, for a post without video, when at least one other signed media field was stored. False when no media field succeeded; the original signed URLs remain.
mediaRehosted.title: Media Rehosted

mediaRehostedAll.description: True when every attempted media field was stored in the Key-Value Store. False when any field failed or was skipped.
mediaRehostedAll.title: All Media Rehosted

mediaRehostedFields.description: Boolean per-field success map derived from rehostStatusByField.
mediaRehostedFields.title: Media Rehosted Fields

mediaSources.description: Original signed URL or URL list for every rehosted field. Rehosted fields also keep a matching <field>Original value.
mediaSources.title: Media Sources

mediaUrlExpiresAt.description: Earliest ISO 8601 UTC expiry across the original signed video, cover, avatar, music and subtitle URLs. It remains the source expiry after rehosting; KV URLs do not use it.
mediaUrlExpiresAt.title: Media URL Expires At

music.description: Sound/music used in the post (id, title, authorName, duration, album, playUrl, coverUrl). After rehosting, playUrl and coverUrl use KV URLs and playUrlOriginal/coverUrlOriginal keep the signed sources.
music.title: Music

place.description: POI object when present: id, name, address, city, province, country, countryCode, category, typeName. No latitude/longitude is invented.
place.title: Place / POI

playsPerHour.description: playCount / ageHours, 1 decimal. Omitted when ageHours is not positive.
playsPerHour.title: Plays Per Hour

position.description: 0-based emitted order within the market/category after filters and dedupe
position.title: Position

postUrl.description: Direct URL to the TikTok post
postUrl.title: Post URL

rank.description: 1-based emitted order within the market/category after filters and dedupe
rank.title: Rank

rehostStatus.description: Record-level outcome: ok, partial, no_media_fields, no_post_url, missing_post_id, no_video_response, navigation_failed, playwright_unavailable, browser_unavailable, body_unavailable, empty_body, invalid_content_type, not_mp4, not_vtt, http_<status>, network_error, capture_error, kv_error, or kv_url_error. Failures keep the original URLs and never drop the record.
rehostStatus.title: Rehost Status

rehostStatusByField.description: Per-field status keyed by output path, for example video.playUrl, video.cover, video.zoomCover.240, music.playUrl, author.avatarUrl, images[0].urlList and subtitles[0].url. Values are ok or a fail-soft status.
rehostStatusByField.title: Rehost Status By Field

scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the run start
scrapedAt.title: Scraped At

shareEnabled.description: Whether sharing is enabled on this post
shareEnabled.title: Share Enabled

stitchEnabled.description: Whether stitching is allowed on this post
stitchEnabled.title: Stitch Enabled

subtitles.description: Subtitle metadata from subtitleInfos, or video.claInfo.captionInfos when subtitleInfos is absent. text is added only with includeTranscripts=true. With rehosting, url is a KV VTT URL and urlOriginal keeps the signed source.
subtitles.title: Subtitles

video.description: Video metadata. With rehostVideo=true, playUrl, downloadUrl, cover, originCover, dynamicCover and zoomCover are stable Key-Value Store URLs, each with a matching <field>Original value and a mediaSources entry. sourcePlayUrl keeps the original signed play URL, and sourceDownloadUrl keeps a distinct signed download URL. Without rehosting, playUrl prefers the working www.tiktok.com/aweme/v1/play/ carrier and downloadUrl falls back to it.
video.title: Video
